summary: The baby (BabyCare: needs and who holds it; BabyHold: the hold poses on any Actor_B skeleton; BabyModel: the baby, the game's own body made a newborn (BabyBody, ChildProportion, ChildSkin; its animations assets/baby/baby_anims.res from tools/baby/make_baby_anims.gd), the procedural bundle only as its fallback; BabyLink: the node side). All numbers here. Coordinates of a pose are in the CHEST FRAME of the holder: the origin is the spined bone, +x the holder's LEFT, +y up, +z the way the holder faces (the rig's own axes), metres, for a holder cradling on the LEFT arm; a right-arm hold mirrors x. A hand target is given in the BABY's frame (x head, y front, z its left) so the hands always end on the baby whatever the pose. Feeding is a modest caregiving hold: the baby at the chest under a shawl.

nursing.summary: Nursing costs the mother food (through her core: stomach, then reserve, never below zero): a share of her hourly burn while the child is under wean_days, and a small flat amount per feed.

care.summary: How the mother acts (BabyLink). A tick every `tick_s` real seconds.

hold.summary: Timing and life of the hold (BabyHold). blend_in / blend_out seconds of the whole hold; pose_blend seconds between poses. Sway is in degrees of body roll while walking (per m/s of speed, capped), the step rate in Hz per m/s; rock is the soothing sway; `upright` how far the chest is brought back upright over whatever the legs' clip does with the back (a work crouch, a hunched sitting clip: the baby is held and seen at the chest; not while reaching).

cradle.summary: The baby in the crook of the near arm, the forearm across the body, the other hand under it.

shoulder.summary: Over the shoulder, the baby upright against the chest, head on the near shoulder: a settled baby, burping.

feed.summary: Seated feeding: the baby held close at the chest in a cradle hold, a shawl over the holder's shoulder and the baby. Nothing shows.

reach.summary: Reaching out with the baby (laying down, taking up, handing over): the baby goes to the world point set with reach_to(); the spine leans to it. The baby lies as in the cradle hold.

infant.summary: ChildLook.infant: the parents' blended face weights (-1..1 face weights of the face engine) go `blend` of the way to the active variant's targets: a short round face, high broad forehead (no brow ridge), big low wide-set eyes, a small low button nose, full round cheeks and a soft jaw with a tiny receding chin, a small full-lipped mouth, small low ears; `sex_scale` softens the head shape toward the female head; `head_mult` [along, through, across] is a small non-uniform roundness on the head scale. The skin is flushed and even, the hair a fine fuzz, the brows very light and thin. Three variants to choose from (`active`).

a.note: moderate: the parents' faces kept, pulled most of the way to baby proportions

b.note: sweet: round open eyes (lids up, a fuller eye), a soft brow, full round cheeks, a small button nose, a tiny soft mouth, a small round chin

c.note: b, and the head a touch rounder (wider, lower)

body.summary: The baby is the game's own character made small (BabyBody: Actor_B + body v4 + the face engine, dressed from the child's look through ChildLook.infant and body_for_stage, in a little linen shift): `scale` the model's overall scale, `form` its proportions (ChildProportion, baked into the baby's own mesh copies: [x across, y up, z front] for the trunk, neck and head, [thickness, length] along the limbs, relative to the adult body at that scale; `round` the head's rounding (HeadRound), `eyes` the eyes' size, `trunk` the soft barrel; baby_body.json has the fields), `neutral_sex` the `sex` fit of the flat asexual child body (ChildLook.body_for_stage), `neck_at` where the neck's base goes in the baby frame (x along the body toward the head), `mouth` the dark mouth inside the lips (adult metres on the head, shown when the mouth opens).

cues.summary: What the face does in each animation (the glb has no face bones): eyes 0 open .. 1 shut (0 blinks on its own), mouth 0 shut .. 1 wide open (pulse: the mouth opens and closes that many times a second, by that much), width the mouth's share of its full width.

model.summary: The baby's colours and the fallback bundle. Lengths in metres; the long axis is x (head at +x), the front +y. `blanket` tints the swaddle (fitted round the baby, `swaddle_margin` off its body, its top `swaddle_top` under the shoulders), `blanket_trim` the fallback bundle's bands, `melanin_skin` the fallback's skin, `shawl` the feeding shawl; length, body_radius, head_radius, head_x, cry_scale are the bundle's only.

cradle.summary: The build piece 'cradle' (Cradle, scripts/building/cradle.gd): where a baby lies to sleep. Baby position on it (piece frame) and the spot a holder stands at.

feed: Hush now, little one. Here, this will settle you.
feed_done: Fed and warm. That's better, isn't it?
change: Let me see to your wrappings, {name}.
A fresh swaddle and you'll be right as rain.
soothe: There now. No need for all that noise.
hand_over: Take {name}, carefully. Your arm under the head.
take_back: I'll take {name}. Poor thing wants feeding, I think.

refuse.far: She is too far away to hand the baby over.
refuse.hands: You need both hands free to hold the baby.
refuse.busy: She is busy with the baby just now.
refuse.held: The baby is already in someone's arms.
